_meta.purpose: Function-to-process-to-system-to-data-asset-to-vendor dependency map for DORA-style analysis. This file lists what IS mapped for each critical service. It does NOT contain a pre-computed 'is this complete' verdict - that judgment should be derived by checking each listed vendor's subcontractors_mapped_in_ict_register field in vendors.json. Several vendors below have that field set to false; that is the checkable, concrete form of the 'incomplete subcontractor mapping' gap Bank_Context_Fictional_Digital_Bank.md describes qualitatively.

dependency_mappings.notes: Matches the critical payment chain named in Bank_Context_Fictional_Digital_Bank.md exactly: payments hub, mobile app, beneficiary store, sanctions engine, fraud engine, customer-notification service, external Verification of Payee provider. SYS-FRAUD-ENGINE has no vendor_id (built in-house), so it does not appear in the vendor list here - check systems.json directly for that system.

VND-MORTGAGE-SERVICER has subcontractors_identified_by_vendor=false and subcontractors_mapped_in_ict_register=false in vendors.json - the weakest-mapped critical service in the whole estate, and the one running on a system NDB does not operate itself.
